I replied to Ilse in a thread on her message in #north-random. I confirmed that the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal is 10 June and that this replaces the date she posted in #north-team this morning.

She said no action was needed, so I only replied. I didn't post in #north-team and didn't change anything else. A renewal date doesn't count as a finance figure, so no approval was needed to discuss it in #north-random.
